hero.title: Connect everything with a single bill
hero.subtitle: Symmetric fibre, unlimited mobile and landline with support from real people. Switch provider in 24 hours with no setup fees.
hero.note: Free number porting · No lock-in · 24/7 support
hero.cardFootnote: Price for life, not an intro offer

pricing.title: Clear monthly fees, every month the same
pricing.subtitle: No hidden costs and no yearly hikes. Pick a category and compare the plans.
pricing.helper: All prices shown are {vat} and include equipment rental.

features.title: A telco that does what it says
features.subtitle: We keep it simple: stable pricing, short contracts and real people on the phone.

price.title: Price for life
price.description: What you sign up for is what you pay. No automatic increases, no offers that expire.

support.title: Local support 24/7
support.description: Our own technical team in Catalonia. No bots, no endless queues: we answer in under two minutes.

network.title: Our own 5G network
network.description: Symmetric fibre and 5G mobile coverage across 98% of the region, with 4G backup included.

flexible.title: Full flexibility
flexible.description: Upgrade, downgrade or cancel whenever you like from your account. No calls, no penalties.

cta.title: We handle the switch for you
cta.subtitle: We take care of the number porting and of cancelling your current provider. You just pick the plan.

page.title: {category} plans
page.subtitle: Compare the monthly fees and sign up online in under five minutes.

portability.question: How long does number porting take?
portability.answer: Between 24 and 48 working hours. You keep your number and you are never left without service.

commitment.question: Is there a minimum term?
commitment.answer: No. You can cancel whenever you want with no penalty and no cancellation fee.

install.question: Who installs the fibre?
install.answer: A Siecom technician, in a time slot you choose. Installation and router are free.

change.question: Can I change plan later on?
change.answer: Yes, from your account and effective on the next billing cycle. At no extra cost.

about.title: A local telco with a first-class network
about.subtitle: We started in 2009 in Girona with a simple idea: give good service and explain things clearly.
about.story: We began laying fibre in villages no operator wanted to reach. Today we connect 120,000 homes and 3,200 businesses, but our commitment is the same: our own network, local support and prices that do not change once the offer ends.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Final prices, two-page contracts and bills you understand the first time.

proximity.title: Proximity
proximity.description: Offices in Girona, Barcelona and Lleida, and technicians who know the area.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.description: We invest 20% of our profits in rolling out fibre in rural areas.
